behavior.arguments: rcx = unsigned index (compared against 0x3f). No other argument is read; rdx is overwritten with 0 before the select, and rax carries the result.

edges.above_threshold: index 0x40 gives cmova taken, so rax = 0; the maximum 64-bit index likewise returns 0.
edges.at_threshold: index 0x3f gives cmova not taken, so rax keeps the lea address 0x576a6c0.
edges.below_threshold: index 0x00 gives cmova not taken, so rax keeps the lea address 0x576a6c0.
edges.unconditional: on every path the window writes no field; the only observable effect is the returned pointer or zero in rax.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; one conditional transfer (cmova, unsigned above); no loop, no calls; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: Return rax = 0x576a6c0 when rcx <= 0x3f (unsigned), else 0. No field is written and no other register value is claimed as a return.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Exactly one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
